description: Cancer and Virgo compatibility in Western astrology: Water and Earth, cardinal and mutable, the 60° sextile between them, and what helps the pairing.
answer: In Western astrology, Cancer (cardinal Water) and Virgo (mutable Earth) sit 60 degrees apart, a complementary match in which each element feeds the other. Cancer is often described as intuitive and nurturing and Virgo as analytical and practical; Sun signs describe tendencies, not outcomes.
ogLine: Cancer and Virgo are a caring, practical pair who show love by looking after each other.

sections.heading: How Cancer and Virgo show up together
paragraphs: Cancer and Virgo are a caring, practical pair who show love by looking after each other. Virgo brings attention and help, Cancer brings emotional warmth. They often build a supportive home; the risk is shared worry and a reluctance to express anger.

Cancer tends to love protectively and deeply. As a Sun sign it is linked with nurturing and emotional memory, so a Cancer partner often creates a sense of home, remembers what matters to people and shows care through attention and looking after them. In conversation with Virgo, Cancer tends to read tone before words and may approach a sensitive subject indirectly, testing whether it is safe to say more.

Virgo tends to love through attention to detail and practical help. The sign is linked with care, precision and modesty, so a Virgo partner often shows affection by noticing what is needed and quietly taking care of it. In conversation with Cancer, Virgo tends to be precise and practical, offering detail, suggestions and the improvement that nobody else spotted.

On first meeting Virgo, Cancer often comes across as kind, attentive and a little reserved, warming noticeably once it feels safe. On first meeting Cancer, Virgo often comes across as thoughtful, modest and observant, offering help before being asked. Put together, Cancer brings emotional care and belonging, while Virgo brings practical care and thoughtful attention.

sections.heading: Water meets Earth: element and modality
paragraphs: Virgo and Cancer combine Earth and Water, which astrology treats as complementary elements: water nourishes earth. Virgo offers stability and practical care, Cancer offers emotional depth and intuition, so this pairing is often nurturing, loyal and protective. The risk is that Virgo and Cancer both become cautious and inward-looking. An Earth-Water pair like Virgo and Cancer tends to do well when it keeps some outside stimulation in its life.

Cancer is a cardinal sign and Virgo is a mutable sign. Cardinal energy initiates and mutable energy adapts, so this pair often works well when one sets a direction and the other adjusts the details. Tension appears if the cardinal partner feels the mutable one will not commit, or the mutable partner feels pushed. Both are receptive signs in traditional astrology (Fire and Air are active, Earth and Water receptive), so Cancer and Virgo tend to meet the world with a similar inward, receptive stance. The traditional keywords for Cancer include intuitive, nurturing and protective, and those for Virgo include analytical, practical and diligent.

sections.heading: The 60° relationship: sextile
paragraphs: Cancer and Virgo sit two signs apart, 60 degrees, which matches the sextile in traditional astrology. Cancer belongs to an element that complements Virgo's, so Cancer and Virgo usually find it easy to cooperate and talk. A Cancer-Virgo sextile is often described as friendly and supportive, with opportunities that grow when Cancer and Virgo both put in some effort. In practice, Cancer and Virgo tend to reward small, regular effort in each other: shared projects, honest conversation and saying yes to each other's ideas.

Counting from Aries, Cancer is sign 4 and Virgo is sign 6, which is where the 60-degree figure comes from: each sign spans 30 degrees. Cancer is ruled by the Moon, which astrology links with feelings, memory and care, and Virgo is ruled by Mercury, the planet astrology links with thought, speech and exchange, so a Cancer-Virgo pairing is often read as Moon meeting Mercury. For Cancer and Virgo, this is a relationship between whole signs rather than an aspect calculated from two birth charts.

sections.heading: Needs, friction and what helps
paragraphs: With Virgo, Cancer usually needs emotional safety, reassurance and a partner who treats family and private life as important. With Cancer, Virgo usually needs order, reliability and a partner who appreciates thoughtful effort rather than grand displays.

When stressed around Virgo, Cancer can retreat into its shell, become moody or hold on to a hurt long after it seemed resolved. Under stress around Cancer, Virgo can become critical, anxious about details and hard on itself or its partner. With a cardinal and a mutable sign, one partner usually wants a decision and the other wants to keep options open, so naming a decision date keeps both comfortable.

What helps Virgo with Cancer is gentleness at the start of hard talks, small reassurances, and honouring family occasions and private rituals. What helps Cancer with Virgo is acknowledging the effort behind its help, clear plans, and gentle reminders that good enough is sometimes enough. Naming Cancer's sensitivity to hurt and Virgo's critical streak as patterns, rather than as faults, tends to make them easier to work with, and much easier to laugh about later.

sections.heading: Cancer and Virgo day to day
paragraphs: At home, Cancer tends to nest, cooking family recipes, keeping photographs on display and making the space feel safe, and it values a Virgo who treats home as sacred. For its part at home, Virgo tends to organise, clean, plan meals and fix small problems before they grow, and it values a Cancer who notices and appreciates that care.

As a teammate, Cancer protects colleagues, remembers personal details and senses morale; alongside a Virgo, it works best where loyalty is returned and feelings are respected. In turn, as a teammate, Virgo checks details, improves processes and quietly prevents mistakes; alongside a Cancer, it works best when its suggestions are welcomed rather than resented. Shared projects that use both the intuitive side of Cancer and the analytical side of Virgo, a trip, a renovation, a joint hobby, tend to show this pairing at its best.

In daily rhythm, Virgo and Cancer often create a homely, protective routine with good food and quiet evenings; inviting friends round now and then brings in the outside energy this cosy pairing can lack.

faq.question: Are Cancer and Virgo compatible?
faq.answer: Cancer and Virgo have complementary elements (Water and Earth) and sit 60 degrees apart, a complementary match in which each element feeds the other. Astrology describes themes rather than scores; for Cancer and Virgo, the themes to watch are Cancer's sensitivity to hurt and Virgo's critical streak.

faq.question: What are the dates and elements of Cancer and Virgo?
faq.answer: In 2026, the Sun is in Cancer from Jun 21 – Jul 22 and in Virgo from Aug 23 – Sep 22. Cancer is a Cardinal Water sign ruled by Moon; Virgo is a Mutable Earth sign ruled by Mercury. Cusp dates can shift by a day between years.

faq.question: What does the 60° angle between Cancer and Virgo mean?
faq.answer: Counting around the zodiac, Virgo sits 60 degrees from Cancer, a sextile in traditional terms. It describes how Cancer and Virgo relate as signs, not an aspect between planets in two people's charts.

faq.question: What might Cancer and Virgo enjoy doing together?
faq.answer: Cancer usually enjoys intimate, nostalgic outings: home-cooked dinners, beach walks, family visits, cosy cafés and revisiting meaningful places, while Virgo usually enjoys useful, calm outings: hiking, cooking classes, farmers' markets, museums, volunteering and well-planned day trips. Alternating who chooses gives both partners a taste of the other's world.
